title: Commercial Interior Design in Bratislava | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Design of offices, salons, shops and boutiques: project, 3D visualization and custom business furniture. Bratislava and Vienna, free consultation.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designs commercial interiors that express the brand’s character, are comfortable for customers and staff, and make good use of every square meter.
We work with offices, stores, boutiques, beauty salons, dental clinics and medical offices, restaurants, cafés, hotels, showrooms, and other commercial properties.
We develop the concept around your business, taking into account your corporate identity, target audience, functional requirements, and the specific features of the space.
We build the layout around your workflows and the way visitors and staff move through the space: we place furniture and equipment, define work areas, and plan the lighting.
In an office, this covers the reception area, meeting rooms, executive offices, workstations, lounge areas, office kitchens, cafeterias, and common areas.
In a store or boutique, it covers sales areas, display windows, fitting rooms, checkout counters, storage systems, and customer flow.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations show the future interior before any work begins: the layout, furniture, materials, colors, lighting, and decor. We use them to agree on the key decisions in advance.

We select materials based on the design, the purpose of the space, the intensity of use, and the budget. In a commercial interior, what matters most is durability, easy maintenance, and materials that keep their appearance under heavy use.
We develop general, task, accent, and decorative lighting scenarios to suit the purpose of the space.
Lighting creates the right atmosphere, highlights products and individual interior features, and makes the space comfortable for visitors and staff.

Custom furniture. DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs furniture for commercial spaces: reception desks, retail fixtures, display cases, shelving units, cabinets, storage systems, desks and conference tables, office kitchens, decorative panels, and other elements.
We prepare detailed drawings and specifications for production. Based on the design, we can also manufacture, deliver, and install the furniture.
An interior can be an extension of a company’s corporate identity: we integrate logos, signage, brand colors, wayfinding, graphics, and decor into the concept.
Depending on the scope of the project, we prepare technical documentation and working drawings, which contractors, furniture manufacturers, and other specialists then work from.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN can oversee the implementation of the project and work with contractors, suppliers, and furniture manufacturers so that the interior turns out the way it was conceived.
In our designs, we take into account the safety, accessibility, functional, and operational requirements of each specific commercial space.
On request, we use natural materials, energy-efficient lighting, and other resource-efficient solutions.
